# Rekordbox fixture

`rekordbox-demo.pdb` is the demo-track device database from rekordcrate 0.3.0, copied from `data/complete_export/demo_tracks/PIONEER/rekordbox/export.pdb`.

Source: https://github.com/Holzhaus/rekordcrate/tree/v0.3.0/data/complete_export/demo_tracks

The upstream package is licensed under MPL-2.0. Its license is included in `COPYING`. This fixture contains database metadata only; no audio is included.
